rules: idea.problem is a non-empty string after existing normalization
idea.capabilities contains at least one non-empty capability after existing normalization
the server does not infer either field from arbitrary root fields

default_profile.immutability: Changing any value or the semantic membership of the license allowlist requires a new profile version and a new contract. Canonical normalization may copy and order slices but may not mutate shared profile state.

materialization_rules.authority: The server applies defaults; JSON Schema default annotations are descriptive and are not trusted as the execution mechanism.
materialization_rules.timing: Defaults are resolved before either injected recommendation port is called and before external search, semantic, discovery or content I/O.

objects.policy: omitted or {} resolves each omitted member from V1
objects.target: omitted or {} resolves name from normalized idea.problem
objects.search: omitted or {} resolves each omitted member from V1

field_precedence.expected: use the exact corresponding V1 value
preserve the supplied semantic value and validate it
reject as Invalid params; null is not omission
reject as Invalid params; do not replace by a default
preserve an explicit empty list; do not replace by a default
accept false; it is value-equivalent to V1 but must never be rejected as missing

field_precedence.class: explicit empty string with invalid domain meaning
field_precedence.expected: reject as Invalid params; do not replace by a default
accept and preserve; it is value-equivalent to V1

field_precedence.expected_at_gateway_port: preserve the explicit empty string, distinguishing it from omitted target.name
field_precedence.expected_in_real_service: the pre-existing L1 target normalization may subsequently resolve an empty or whitespace-only name to normalized idea.problem, preserving the meaning of a previously valid complete request

materialization_rules.copy_semantics: Each invocation receives request-owned license and locale slices. A caller or downstream consumer mutating one request cannot change defaults observed by a later invocation.

dynamic_default_annotation.form: a human-readable description or a JSON Schema annotation that unambiguously says omitted target.name uses idea.problem

preserved_constraints: search.locales uniqueItems and existing ten-locale enum

bateia_start_recommendation.schema_relation: The idea, policy, target and search property schemas are deeply equal to bateia_recommend at the same tools/list observation.
bateia_start_recommendation.other_durable_tools: schemas and behavior preserved from Step 0026

mcp_schema_contract.runtime_schema_parity: Every payload rejected by preserved schema type/range/additionalProperties constraints is rejected by runtime with -32602 before a downstream port call.

sync_async_parity.comparison: Remove the async-only idempotency_key and compare the RecommendationRequest captured by the two injected ports.
sync_async_parity.requirement: For byte-equivalent recommendation arguments, sync and async deliver deeply equal default-resolved requests, including nil-versus-empty slice semantics where JSON can distinguish them.
sync_async_parity.full_request_requirement: A previously valid complete request is accepted by both paths and retains its previous semantic values.
sync_async_parity.error_requirement: The same invalid recommendation member is -32602 in both paths and neither downstream port is called.

preserved: all Step 0025 validation ranges and enums
meaning of every previously valid complete request
idempotency validation and durable operations from Step 0026
public result projection, status, sanitization and error classes
explicitly_superseded: Step 0026 start root required array idempotency_key,idea,policy,target,search

license_policy.meaning: policy.allowed_licenses is an acceptance allowlist, not candidate metadata
license_policy.omitted: materialize the exact V1 permissive SPDX allowlist
license_policy.explicit_empty: preserve empty and let existing decision semantics evaluate it; never repopulate it
license_policy.unknown_candidate: retain the candidate's unknown/inconclusive evidence status and existing warning or blocker semantics; never write a V1 license identifier into candidate evidence
license_policy.proven_disallowed_candidate: remains disallowed according to existing decision behavior
license_policy.legal_boundary: The V1 allowlist is curated and versioned but is not a claim of legal completeness or compatibility for a particular use.

unknown_policy.invalid_input: Fail closed with JSON-RPC -32602 and zero downstream port calls for unknown fields, explicit null, wrong types, invalid explicit values, missing business intent or trailing JSON values.
unknown_policy.opaque_domain_evidence: Preserve INCONCLUSIVE/Unknown for missing or unsupported candidate-license evidence. A default allowlist is not evidence.
unknown_policy.contract_evaluation: Unknown never counts as Preserved for a positive case or Violated for a negative mutation. It is accepted only for an explicitly opaque case.
unknown_policy.indistinguishable_provenance: When an explicit value equals its default, public value equality cannot prove whether an implementation internally defaulted or preserved it. Only acceptance and the resulting value are contracted; internal provenance remains Unknown.
